parts.text: Explain why Muslims believe the Qurʾan originated with God.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Different literal and metaphorical perspectives do not challenge the authority of the Qurʾan.’
Do you agree? You should refer to different points of view in your answer. 
OR

Explain how individuals may interpret teachings (ijtihad) according to one school of thought in
Islam.

‘Individual interpretation of teachings (ijtihad) is still valid today.’ Evaluate this statement with
